name: The Undertow Verdict
hook: This is the deepest receding the Litany Sea has ever dared: a spring ebb that bares the drowned cathedral floor in three falling stages, and with it the worst of Veyl's dreaming grief. The Ash Iconoclasts came to silence the cathedral for good. The Sediment…
setup: Play on a 4x4 board divided into a 6x6 zone grid: the drowned cathedral floor. Lay the double-sided wet/dry overlays so the central 3x4 block of zones (the nave) begins Brine-deep, and the surrounding aisle ring begins Dry. Place 8 crystals, the Litany of the cathedral: 5 in the wet nave, 3 scattered loose across the dry aisles. Set a Tide Track of 6 notches, and mark notches 2 and 4 with a colored band: these are the two STAGE BREAKS. Pre-define the dry-flip bands so the nave recedes from the OUTSIDE IN: the aisle-facing nave zones flip first (notches 1 and 2), the deep center flips last (notches 5 and 6), the inverse of an ordinary ebb. The Grief pool starts at zero. Place a Hold box off…
deployment: Diagonal deployment. The Ash Iconoclasts and the Sediment deploy in OPPOSITE corners, each confined to a 10-inch quadrant: they are the axis of this fight and must stare across the whole board at each other. The Mnemarchs and the Brine-Factors deploy along the two remaining board edges, within 6 inches of their edge. No model may begin in a Brine-deep zone (you cannot start standing in the Sea). After deployment, whichever faction has the FEWEST models on the board takes the first activation: the underdog reads the water first.
objectives: Scoring changes by stage, and the Toll decides the stage. A crystal can only ever be claimed ONCE, by the first method that fully resolves on it. STAGE ONE (rounds 1-2, the Choir's Hour): only SET crystals (Mnemarchs) and LIQUIDATED crystals taken into Hold (Brine-Factors) score. These are wet-side acts. STAGE TWO (rounds 3-4, the Breaking Hour): only SHATTERED crystals (Ash Iconoclasts) and DROWNED crystals re-covered into play (Sediment) score. These are dry-side acts; Setting and Liquidating still physically happen but bank zero points this stage. STAGE THREE (rounds 5-6, the Undertow): ALL four methods score again, and every crystal whose fate is recorded on the Undertow Track scores…
twist: At the second Stage Break (the start of round 5, the Undertow proper), the deepest nave zones, the last wet ground and the safest crystals all game, begin to dry from the CENTER OUTWARD, reversing every prior tide. The crystals everyone treated as untouchable vault stock are Exposed all at once,…
